verdict.rationale: Ramp documents international wires for bill payments (free, alongside same-day ACH) and eligible stablecoin (USDC) Bill Pay, so cross-border sending exists. Its only instant-speed claim is RTP, which is a US domestic rail ('Vendors get paid 2 days faster'), and nothing shows foreign payments arriving in under a minute. missing for 10: documented sub-minute settlement for international payments, speed or SLA claims for international wires or USDC payouts, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-border arrival times.
